title: A chapter "Solvers and system equations"
author: Claude-JG
description: The system equations of motion are a hidden subsection of "Solvers in Exudyn", and the system Jacobians are not described there. Decided: the chapter renamed, with a section on the system equations, the solvers and the Jacobians.
releaseNotes: The chapter Solvers and system equations describes the system equations and the system Jacobian: the local Jacobians of the items, the parallel assembly, the options and what the Jacobian leaves out.
